---
name: Slide deck generation
description: Conventions and pitfalls for building Dime Time .pptx decks (Google Slides import)
---

Decks are generated by python-pptx scripts kept next to their output in `attached_assets/<name>-slides/` (patent + timeline decks follow this).

**Pitch deck:** fully regenerated by `generate_full_deck.py` (same dir) as of 2026-07-21 — 14 native-text slides (searchable PDF, sequential "NN / 14" footers, cover unnumbered); the old PNG-stack build and `generate_updated_slides.py` are superseded. With-ip variant appends 3 IP PNG slides (`appendix-ip-*.png`, own "IP · n / 3" numbering — no conflict). Re-run script → soffice pdf → pdftoppm to refresh `slide-NN-*.png` previews. Deck honesty rules baked in per Tim's 2026-07-21 revision doc: live/built-gated/pending/planned badges, no invented metrics or SAFE cap ($150K post-money SAFE ask), no "only platform"/"first system"/replication-timeline claims, capability-matrix competition (no named competitors), bottom-up ARR examples (subs × $2.99 × 12), EIN/DUNS excluded, legal entity "Dime Time Technologies LLC". Verified stats: $18.8T household / $1.25T credit-card debt (NY Fed Q1 2026, May 2026 release), 91% smartphone (Pew 2025) — re-verify before any figure change. Current-design product screenshots live in `attached_assets/Dime-Time-App-Store-Screenshots-FINAL/iPhone-6.9/` (1290×2796, v1.0.5, the actual App Store Connect uploads) — use these for any phone imagery, never the old mockup phones.

**How to verify:** render with `soffice --headless --convert-to pdf` then `pdftoppm -png` and visually inspect every slide — text overflow/wrap bugs are invisible otherwise.

**Pitfalls learned:**
- Emoji in shapes render as tofu boxes in LibreOffice and are unreliable across viewers — use colored oval shapes + text labels instead.
- Long words in narrow shapes wrap mid-word ("MERCURY" → "MERCUR Y"); size fonts to fit the widest word.
- 40pt titles longer than ~28 chars wrap and collide with body text below; pass a smaller title size for long titles.
- Unicode ✓/✗/→ are safe; partner logos are NOT allowed (locked project rule) — names + marks only.

**Brand spec:** lavender #918EF4, deep #4A468F, dark #2D2A4A, light #F5F4FE; Poppins font (in Google Fonts, renders natively after Slides import); transparent logo at `attached_assets/patent-deck-slides/_logo_transparent.png`; 16:9 (13.333×7.5 in).
